harper: Heads up, release-bot just bumped the logging PR to a minor (v4.1.0). It only changes log wording and a non-exported helper. Can someone confirm this is over-eager?

release-bot: deploy analysis: touched files: src/logging/*, src/internal/logger_utils.rs, docs/observability.md -> heuristic: src edits -> default minor. Overrides: PR title tokens [PATCH]/[MINOR] or CLI flag --force-patch.

dan: That sounds wrong. Non-exported helpers should not trigger minor. We should restrict 'minor' to changes in public API surface (pub mod/exports/routes).

ivy: Agreed. Quick fix: retitle PR with [PATCH] and release-bot will switch. But we should also ask for a change in heuristics.

shawn: Can we add a safe-default: if only non-public files match (no pub fn, no exported types), prefer patch even if in src/? Makes a lot of noise otherwise.

release-bot: enhancement logged: rfc#semver-heuristics-14 (surface-sensitivity). New rule proposed: default->patch if no exported symbols changed. CLI override remains `./tools/releasebot release --force-minor` or `--force-patch`.

harper: I'll retitle with [PATCH] and run the force-patch job. Also posting a short note to #release-notes to avoid product confusion.

dan: One more ask: when release-bot tags automatically, can it include the reason in the git tag message and in the PR body? Example: "reason: src change but only internal helpers -> switched to patch per author". That would reduce ping storms.

release-bot: will add one-line rationale to tag bodies and PR comments in next patch release. Current workaround: add `semver: patch` in PR body frontmatter.

ivy: Also propose a soft rule in the playbook: prefer patch during code freeze windows unless change is user-visible. We'll add wording and examples.

shawn: Small ops point: when forcing patch, ensure changelog generator doesn't drop the note into 'Features' bucket. Use frontmatter `section: Bugfixes` in PR body.

harper: Retitled and forced patch; tag applied v4.0.3. Posting to release-notes: "v4.0.3 (patch) - internal logging wording; no API changes" :white_check_mark:

dan: Thanks. Filing a short RFC to tighten heuristics and add the tag rationale: https://git.internal/rex/rfcs/semver-heuristics-14

harper: Closing this thread.
